name: MultiWooManager
author: MultiWooManager

sections.description:
MultiWooManager is the ultimate solution for streamlining and enhancing product management across one or more WooCommerce stores. By integrating directly with the MultiWooManager web-based application, you can connect and sync multiple WooCommerce sites in just a few clicks, bringing all of your product data and settings into one centralized dashboard.

This seamless integration offers centralized management for multiple WooCommerce stores, saving you time and effort when dealing with large product catalogs.

Key Features:
– Connect Multiple Stores – Quickly link multiple WooCommerce sites to manage inventory and product details from a single, unified interface.
– Product Recognition Across Sites – Instantly see which products exist on each connected store for seamless multi-store product tracking.
– Centralized Editing & SEO Optimization – Update product information—titles, descriptions, and SEO metadata—across all stores at once, improving search visibility and saving time.
– AI-Assisted Product Creation – Utilize AI to translate product details automatically and create listings with a single click, ensuring consistency and a streamlined workflow.
– Quick Store-Wide Actions – Change products’ status or visibility across any or all stores simultaneously, making large-scale inventory or catalog changes effortless.
– Bulk Editing & Synchronization – Execute mass updates and sync changes instantly to all selected stores, eliminating redundant tasks and reducing errors.

Important notes:
MultiWooManager WordPress plugin is essential for WooCommerce stores looking to connect with our external website platform, MultiWooManager. By installing this plugin, your site becomes eligible for integration with the MultiWooManager platform.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See the GPLv2 License for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin
    Upload the multi-woo-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the Plugin
    Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.

  3. Connect to MultiWooManager
    If registered, open the MultiWooManager application directly by clicking the “Open MultiWooManager” button in the WordPress admin top bar.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without the MultiWooManager PaaS application?

Yes, it provides custom REST API endpoints for WooCommerce products that can be used independently. However, its primary purpose is to integrate with the MultiWooManager platform for more robust, centralized products management.

Is the usage of the MultiWooManager platform free?

No, the MultiWooManager platform is a paid service, but it includes a 14-day free trial. Visit https://multiwoomanager.com/ for more details on pricing and features.

How does the AI-assisted product creation work?

The plugin leverages AI to automatically translate your product content and generate new listings across connected stores. This functionality streamlines your workflow by ensuring consistent product information and branding with just a single click.

1.2.1

  • Added Smart Image synchronization compatibility for ACF image fields, fixed product synchronization bugs & ACF repeater field Ai translations.

1.2.0

  • Added Tag Mapping system & Tag editing functionality. Introduced Smart Image synchronization for faster product image updates across multiple stores.

1.1.9

  • Implemented product duplication functionality

1.1.8

  • Fixed order of ACF fields to ensure they are displayed in the correct sequence.

1.1.7

  • Fixed product’s catalog visibility value synchronization

1.1.6

  • Fixed a recursion bug where prefixes were lost in nested ACF group fields.

1.1.5

  • Initial release.
  • Added initial custom REST API endpoints to improve product management efficiency.
  • Added admin top bar button for quick access to the MultiWooManager platform.
